## Details

<a id="work_bitmap"></a>
### [`work_bitmap`](../../../../src/data/work_bitmap.asm#L6) `$A69A-$A6B9`

*variable*

Work bitmap of the fight area: 8 character rows of 320 bytes (bitmap rows 14-21). The fighters are drawn here. The arena change at $8e8d also uses $a69a-$b699 as 16 rows of 256 bytes and swaps it with $d000-$dfff.

- **Referred to by:** [`draw_fighter`](../fighter/draw.md#draw_fighter)

<a id="work_strip0"></a>
### [`work_strip0`](../../../../src/data/work_bitmap.asm#L9) `$A6BA-$A7F9`

*variable*

Columns 4-35 of each work bitmap row start at $a6ba+320k (256 bytes). $8cc7 copies them to the screen bitmap.

- **Read by:** [`show_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#show_work_bitmap)
- **Written by:** [`restore_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#restore_work_bitmap)
